seo.title: Track Easy — Simple Habit Tracker for iOS
seo.description: Track habits without the hassle. Add a habit in a sentence, keep your streaks, and check off habits from Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: HABIT TRACKER
hero.title: Track habits without the hassle.
text: Build better habits with a tracker that respects your time. Ink on paper, with color only where it means something. No sign-up, no subscriptions, no data collection. Just you and your habits.

items.title: Add in a Sentence
items.text: Type a habit the way you'd say it, like "Read 20 min every weekday", and Track Easy fills in the schedule, icon and color. Or start from over 30 templates. Unlimited habits, no premium tier.

items.title: Streak Tracking
items.text: Your streaks lead the Today screen, measured against your personal best, with a heads-up when one is at risk. Already doing a habit? Set the day you started and carry your streak over.

items.title: Calendar View
items.text: A ring shows a day in progress and a filled circle marks a day you finished everything. Forgot to log yesterday? Catch up in a tap.

items.title: Interactive Widgets
items.text: Check off habits from your Home Screen or Lock Screen without opening the app, in any Home Screen style. The Streak widget keeps your best run, or any habit's, in view.

items.title: Siri & Shortcuts
items.text: Check off a habit hands-free. Just ask Siri, or build it into your own Shortcuts.

items.title: Statistics
items.text: Your longest streaks, completion rates, the last seven days and your most consistent habits, at a glance.

items.title: Your Accent
items.text: Pick one of eight accents to mark your streaks. It sets the app icon too, with dark and tinted versions, and the widgets.

items.title: Day or Night
items.text: Follow your iPhone or pick Light or Dark. After dark, choose soft Graphite or true OLED Black.

items.title: Gentle Reminders
items.text: One daily reminder that names what's left and which streak is at stake, and stays quiet once you're done.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your habits stay yours.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking. No cloud sync. Your habit data lives on your device and nowhere else. Zero data collection, period.

cta.title: Start building habits.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
